name: Il Mio Gatto ed Io, Veterinari riservati ai gatti a Roma
address: Via Gregorio VII, 316, 00165 Roma RM, Italia
short_description: Feline veterinary clinic offering cat-only consultations, ultrasound, X-ray and dental surgery.
short_description_local: Clinica veterinaria per soli gatti con visite dedicate, ecografia, radiografia e cure dentali.
description: Veterinary clinic dedicated exclusively to cats, certified as a Cat Friendly Clinic by iCatCare. The clinic provides 30-minute consultations by appointment, quiet feline waiting areas, ultrasound, digital radiography, and dentistry. Post-surgical recovery areas and feline health plans are also available on site.
description_local: Clinica veterinaria dedicata esclusivamente ai gatti, certificata come Cat Friendly Clinic da iCatCare. La struttura offre visite da 30 minuti su appuntamento, sala d'attesa felina, ecografia, radiografia e odontoiatria. Sono inoltre disponibili degenza post-chirurgica e piani salute dedicati.
emergency_note: Urgent appointments available during clinic hours; referral to 24-hour emergency hospital outside opening hours.
emergency_note_local: Appuntamenti d'urgenza disponibili durante l'orario; fuori orario riferimento al pronto soccorso h24.

name: Centro Veterinario Jonio
short_description: Veterinary clinic providing routine check-ups, surgery, endoscopy and care for exotic pets.
short_description_local: Ambulatorio veterinario con visite di base, chirurgia, endoscopia e cura di animali esotici.
description: Veterinary clinic offering medical care for domestic pets and exotic animals. Services include digital radiography, ultrasound, routine and laparoscopic surgery, endoscopy, orthopedics, and ophthalmology. The clinic also provides laboratory diagnostics, day hospital, home visits, and travel health certificates.
description_local: Centro veterinario che offre cure mediche per animali da compagnia e animali esotici. I servizi comprendono radiografia digitale, ecografia, chirurgia tradizionale e laparoscopica, endoscopia, ortopedia e oculistica. La struttura fornisce inoltre analisi di laboratorio, day hospital, visite domiciliari e certificati di viaggio.
emergency_note: Day clinic with daytime hospitalization only; transfers organized to a 24-hour facility if needed.
emergency_note_local: Clinica diurna con ricovero solo diurno; trasferimento organizzato presso struttura h24 se necessario.
